name: Dropdown
description: A menu of actions or choices that opens from a button, with icons, descriptions, shortcuts, sections and submenus.

props.name: children
props.description: A button that opens the menu, then the DropdownMenu.

props.name: trigger
props.description: How the button opens the menu.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state (controlled). Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.description: DropdownItem, DropdownSection, DropdownSeparator and DropdownSubmenu elements, or a function rendering each of items.

props.name: items
props.description: Items for a dynamic menu.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when an item is chosen.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Lets items be chosen. Chosen items show a dot (single) or a check (multiple).

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Chosen items (controlled). Use defaultSelectedKeys when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the chosen items change.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Overrides the mark for chosen items.

props.name: placement
props.default: "bottom start", or "end top" in a submenu
props.description: Where the menu opens. It flips when there is no room.

props.name: offset
props.description: Gap from the trigger in pixels.

props.name: popoverClassName
props.description: Classes for the floating surface, e.g. a width. It is at least 200 pixels and as wide as the trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the list inside the surface. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Menu.

props.name: children
props.description: The label.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the item in onAction and selectedKeys.

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16 pixel icon or a small avatar before the label.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A key hint at the end of the row, e.g. "⌘D".

props.name: tone
props.description: Destructive paints the row camellia, with a camellia-soft highlight. Warning paints it yuzu, for a choice that is allowed but risky, with a yuzu-soft highlight.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text for type-ahead when the label is not a plain string.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when the item is chosen.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the item a link.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the item.

props.name: title
props.description: A small heading over the group.

props.name: children
props.description: The items, or a function rendering each of items.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Lets the items in this group be chosen, apart from the rest of the menu.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Chosen items in this group (controlled).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the chosen items in this group change.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the hairline.

props.name: children
props.description: The DropdownItem that opens it, then its DropdownMenu.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds of hover before it opens. The right arrow key opens it at once.
